provenance.method: Reviewed complete performed transcript blocks; initial region shown from playback zero (sung onset not measured). Degenerate verse starts require the original numbered publisher MIDI verse and its opening phrase, original tempo retained, harmony/melody four-path agreement, transcript-derived onset bounds, and another acoustically verified verse. Other changes retain original contextual acoustic checks; other recordings retain chroma-DTW correspondence checks. Explicitly reviewed Chinese refrain homophones require two literal-confirmed complete source repeats, at least 50 percent literal and 80 percent exact tone-free syllable correspondence; original text is preserved.
